engineering_counter_limits: Counters count rows and serialized logical raw_index payload returned by public Store.search; they do not count physical SQLite IO or attribute wall time.
Baseline and opt-in with existing inline cache both return 83 rows and two inline raw_index rows. Legacy inline rows are not deleted or migrated by implementation.
A disposable test-only deletion simulates absence of an old inline cache: 81 rows, zero raw_index rows/bytes. This is not a formal fresh-bank performance cohort.
All full Source/record enumeration, direct get calls, index hashing and persistence still have costs. No sublinear cache or measured acceleration claim.
limitations: Explicit memory_derived_index_storage=owner_bank_v1 only. bank_prefix default and R3 freeze unchanged.
Only derived raw_index storage moves. No Source/record/history/packet migration, canonical/product/schema edit, rank/gate/budget change or case-specific routing.
Old inline index remains untouched and continues prefix scan cost; first opt-in retrieval rebuilds from current authoritative documents rather than migrating old payload.
Engineering tests use deterministic vectors and len(text)//4, not actual semantic embedding quality or Qwen tokenizer admission.
No formal 100/1000/10000 benchmark, measured speedup, full causal profile, long-horizon semantic gain or model method comparison.
No Root R4 running source mutation or cherry-pick. Root must freeze and choose any later execution cohort.
Historical WIP doc remains as original pause evidence; these new command receipts do not rewrite its historical state.
